entities.summary: Carsten Egeberg Borchgrevink was a Norwegian polar explorer and a pioneer of Antarctic travel. He inspired Sir Robert Falcon Scott, Sir Ernest Shackleton, Roald Amundsen, and others associated with the Heroic Age of Antarctic Exploration. Carsten Borchgrevink was a explorers & navigators from Christiania (1864-12-01, Christiania–1934-04-21). Holds notable historical significance, documented across 0 language editions of Wikipedia.
